metadata.title: Organizational Policy Control Templates
metadata.remarks: Template component definition for organizational policy controls. These controls require documentation from the authorizing organization, not technical implementation. Each implemented-requirement contains a TEMPLATE marker that organizations must replace with their specific policies and procedures.

components.title: Organizational Security Policies and Procedures
components.description: Template for organizational security policies and procedures covering awareness/training (AT), planning (PL), program management (PM), personnel security (PS), risk assessment (RA), and system acquisition (SA) control families. Organizations must customize these templates with their specific policies.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 organizational policy controls (templates)
